artworks.title: Large Thistle
artworks.medium: etching and roulette in black on chine collé
artworks.description: The image shows a ground-level view of a natural scene with large thistle plants dominating the foreground. The plants have sprawling leaves and intricate flower heads. The ground slopes away, with grass tufts along a pathway leading into the distance. The horizon merges with the sky, which features light clouds. The image is monochromatic, using black and white shades to create depth and contrast, giving it an etched appearance.

artworks.title: Large Coltsfoot
artworks.medium: etching and roulette in black on chine collé
artworks.description: This detailed engraving depicts a view from eye level facing a large cluster of oversized leaves dominating the scene. The horizon is low with no significant features breaking through. The artwork features meticulous line work capturing intricate details in the leaves and texture in the landscape. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of grey, black, and white highlighting depth and shadow. Closest to the viewer are large leaves, with a path on the left leading through the terrain. On the right, tall grasses and trees extend into the distance. Softly shaded clouds in the background provide depth and atmosphere.

artworks.title: One of the Hesperides
artworks.medium: transfer tracing on oiled laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
overall (size of closed album): 52.2 x 35.5 cm (20 9/16 x 14 in.)
page size (greenish pages): 48.6 x 33 cm (19 1/8 x 13 in.)
page size (white pages): 50.5 x 33.4 cm (19 7/8 x 13 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body sketch of a person in a classical style. The person is depicted standing in profile with their head turned slightly to the side. Their facial features are drawn with minimal detail and they have short hair. They are wearing a long robe, and their arms are positioned downwards and outwards with the left arm extended slightly away from the body. The feet are visible, indicating that the person is barefoot. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Giorgione Barbarelli
artworks.artist: Cornelis van Dalen I, after Titian
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This image shows a man in a portrait from the head to mid-torso. He has long, dark hair, a full beard, and a styled mustache. He wears formal attire with a high collar and layered fabric. The man's facial features include deep-set eyes and a steady gaze. There are no visible accessories, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: A Roman Legion
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of Roman soldiers and standard-bearers. The artwork depicts a group of soldiers in detailed armor and shields. Each soldier wears traditional Roman military attire including helmets with crest decorations. Some soldiers carry staffs with insignia. The soldiers stand closely together, conveying unity and order. The background shows sparse foliage details. The style is classical Roman with detailed linework emphasizing muscle definition and textile intricacies.

artworks.title: The Holy Family with Saint Elizabeth and Saint John the Baptist
artworks.artist: Workshop of Jacob Matham, after Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts four figures in flowing robes in a natural landscape. A young woman holds an infant, a second woman communicates with a child, and an older man stands behind them. They are surrounded by a grassy area with a tree, hills, and distant trees in the background.

artworks.title: J.-B. Rebel
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper [unique proof impression of the second state]
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 34.7 x 26 cm (13 11/16 x 10 1/4 in.); cut to platemark
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated at a writing desk, holding a quill pen over a sheet of paper. He has round facial features, curly hair styled in an 18th-century manner, and is dressed in a light-colored coat. The desk has music paper on it, and there is an upholstered chair behind him. The background is dark and textured.

artworks.title: A Man with a Moustache and Goatee, Facing Right
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: plate: 14.1 x 11.3 cm (5 9/16 x 4 7/16 in.), cut to platemark
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body, focusing on his head and shoulders. The man is facing slightly to his left with his head turned toward the viewer, capturing a three-quarter view of his face. He has curly short hair, a prominent mustache, and detailed facial features. He is wearing a garment with a high, decorated collar featuring a crisscross pattern and intricate stitching, with buttons and textured fabric suggesting it is a coat or similar clothing. The background is plain, emphasizing the detailed linework of the engraving or etching artwork.

artworks.title: A Man with a Moustache and Goatee, Facing Forward
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person's head and upper shoulders. The individual is in a three-quarter view, with curly hair, prominent eyebrows, a mustache, and a serious expression. They are wearing a high-collared, patterned outer garment. The background is plain paper texture.

artworks.title: Adolph Menzel
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on chine collé
artworks.creditLine: Given by Art Information Volunteers and Friends in Honor of Christopher B. With
artworks.description: The image shows a side profile of a man's head and upper shoulders facing to the right. He has a prominent nose, high forehead, bald crown with tufts of hair on the sides, sideburns, and a full beard. He has a neutral expression with eyes looking forward, wearing a dark garment that covers his shoulders. The background is plain with no discernible objects or jewelry in sight. The image is an engraved print with detailed line work.

artworks.title: Wine Barrels Loaded onto a Sailing Barge at Vevey
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a calm water scene with a wooden vessel as the focal point, seen from a slightly elevated point of view. There is a small sailing boat visible in the distance to the left. The brushstrokes are delicate and precise. The color palette is soft with gentle browns, blues, and whites dominating. Close to the viewer, there is a simple wooden pier with a few figures in conversation or interaction. In the background, the main vessel has its sails partially unfurled, and to the right, a small rowboat rests on the water's surface.

artworks.title: The Dancer Holoke-GO-Zen
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and roulette on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman reclining in a side profile. She has her head slightly tilted upwards and her hair is styled up. She is wearing a patterned or textured dress. There is no visible jewelry. The background is textured with light and shadow. The setting appears intimate and quiet.

artworks.title: A Winter's Morning
artworks.medium: photogravure
artworks.creditLine: Carolyn Brody Fund and Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a frozen pond with snow-covered banks, a bare tree on the right, a person walking away, and another figure on a wooden bridge. Snow blankets the landscape, with distant trees and bushes also covered. The scene is depicted in muted tones of grey and sepia, giving it a serene and quiet feel.

artworks.title: Chartres Cathedral. Right Door of the Royal Portal, West Side, XII Century
artworks.medium: photogravure
artworks.description: The image shows a stone sculpture with standing figures carved into the pillars of a structure. The figures wear draped robes and have halos around their heads. The stone is weathered and aged, and the figures are life-sized. Smaller carvings and patterns decorate the pillars. More carved figures and scenes are visible on the surrounding panels.

artworks.title: The Artist's Wife Esther
artworks.medium: red chalk on thin laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a person from the shoulders up. The person is in a seated or slightly leaning forward position, with their head tilted to one side and directed downwards. Their facial expression is serene, with delicate features and high cheekbones. The hair is styled back, with a cloth or veil partially covering it. The person appears to be wearing a garment with draped fabric around the neck. The drawing is on a plain background, without visible objects or detailed scenery. There are no visible objects or jewelry on the figure.

artworks.title: The Artist's Sister, Marie von Kalckreuth
artworks.medium: graphite on heavy wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up of an individual's upper body and head. The person is in a reclining position, with their head resting on a surface that suggests a pillow. Their facial features are detailed with lightly shaded lines depicting a serious expression and direct gaze from their eyes. The hair is short and loosely textured with subtle shading to suggest volume. Their clothing, drawn with light lines, appears to be a ruffled or frilled garment at the collar. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held in the image. The background is minimal, composed of simple pencil lines that suggest the outline of a pillow or cushioned surface surrounding the head, with no other distinct features or elements.

artworks.title: The Artist's Children Wolf and Anna Asleep
artworks.medium: charcoal on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows two children asleep in bed. They are lying on their backs with their heads resting on pillows. The child on the left has short or closely cropped hair and their face is round with closed eyes. The child on the right has longer, curly hair falling around their face, which also shows closed eyes. Both children are dressed in light-colored nightgowns, and they are covered partially by blankets. The surrounding area appears calm and dimly lit. The bed is situated in a room with a plain background. There are no visible signs of jewelry or objects being held by the children.

artworks.title: Susanna and the Elders
artworks.medium: woodcut in black, heightened with white gouache, on blue laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 28 x 17.6 cm (11 x 6 15/16 in.) (trimmed to image)
artworks.description: The image shows three figures. The central figure is a woman seated next to a water source, with water at her feet. She is seated with her body slightly turned to the side. Two older men stand closely behind her, with one reaching out towards her. The woman has long hair and is partially covered with a cloth on her head. The men have curly hair and pronounced facial features. They are dressed in long-sleeved garments. The background includes an architectural structure with an arched window and stonework, surrounded by trees.

artworks.title: Benjamin Fillon
artworks.medium: etching in red and black on Japan laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an etched portrait of a man. He is facing slightly to the left, with distinct facial features including a furrowed brow, deep-set eyes, and a prominent nose. His hair is wavy and pushed back, with facial hair in the form of a mustache and a small chin beard. The man is wearing formal attire, including a buttoned coat, collared shirt, and a scarf or cravat around his neck. The background is plain, and there is an inscription along the left side that reads "C. MERYON sc."

artworks.title: The Apparition
artworks.medium: mezzotint on Japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Given by Art Information Volunteers and Friends in Honor of Christopher B. With
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals from the waist up, both draped in fabric. The figure on the left appears to be a man with facial features obscured by shadow, and his head is covered with a cloth that drapes down around his shoulders. The figure on the right, seemingly a woman, is slightly in front and facing more towards the viewer; her face is softly illuminated. Her hair is covered by a wrap similar to the other figure, and she is looking upwards. Both individuals are dressed in long, flowing garments that appear to be robes, draped in layers. They are holding their hands in front of them. The background is dark, and there is no visible scenery beyond the two figures. The lighting suggests an intimate setting, possibly candlelit, casting a warm glow on their garments.

artworks.title: Zephyr and Psyche
artworks.medium: crayon-manner lithograph on wove paper [proof before title]
artworks.description: This image depicts two individuals floating in the air. The person on the left is leaning forward and looking towards the other. She has finely detailed facial features and styled hair. Draped in flowing fabric, a ribbon-like piece floats behind them. The person on the right is bare-chested, muscular, and holding a billowing cloth above them. Their hair is tousled. Both figures are suspended against a light backdrop resembling a pale sky. Below them are rocky peaks and a distant horizon.

artworks.title: Vue des Remparts de Sonnenstein (View of the Ramparts of Sonnenstein)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an overhead view of a townscape, featuring buildings, a church with a tall spire, a circular tower, fortified walls with cannons, and trees. The composition includes a sky with wispy clouds, a horizon with water, and distant architectural structures. The etching style is detailed, with fine lines depicting the textures of stone buildings and tree foliage. The color scheme is monochromatic, using black and white tones.

artworks.title: Angled Beauty
artworks.medium: softground etching and aquatint in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures against an abstract backdrop. One figure is kneeling while the other is standing. Abstract shapes and patterns swirl around and behind them, creating a textured effect.

artworks.title: Nocturne
artworks.medium: softground etching in black on green wove paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of two figures amidst a backdrop of abstract shapes and foliage. The artwork presents two indistinct figures, rendered in a monochrome palette. They appear to be interacting with each other amidst abstract shapes resembling leaves or floral motifs. The forms and figures are not sharply defined, suggesting a dreamlike quality. This is in the style of Arthur B. Davies.
